page.layout: One page of running text. Printed line numbers (10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) run down the right margin. Running head "TRIUMPHUS" at the top, page number "104" at the top left. Catchword "X. ARITH-" at the lower right.

main_text.l: communis, phantasia, & memoria. Motus est respiratio,
pulsus, appetitus sensitiuus (isque partim cupiditas, par-
tim affectus) locomotiua, vigilia, & somnus. In homine
est vita intellectiua, eaque tum intellectus agentis & pa-
tientis, tum voluntatis, idque vel in hac vita, vel post
hanc vitam. Atque hic est locus communis physicus de
vita, amplissimus quidem ille & vtilissimus. Huc refer
quae passim in Scripturis occurrunt de coloribus, odori-
bus, calore, frigore, saporibus, fame, siti, visu, auditu,
guftu &c.
XI. Plenitudo mundi est, qua nullum in mun-
do est vacuum. Mundus enim est corpus continuum
& contiguum, spiritu aereo & caelesti, omnia replente &
fouente, plenum. Hinc pendet connexio omnium cor-
porum adeo firma & indissolubilis, vt vacuum a nullo
mortalium vel angelorum in hanc mundanam scenam
introduci possit. Confer Hof. 2. v. 21. 22.
XII. Figura mundi est circularis. Haec siqui-
dem figura est pulcherrima & perfectissima, in praecipuis
mundi corporibus a Deo expressa. Quod autem ex Apoc.
21. adfertur de quadratura caelestis Hierosolymae, id est
mysticum.
XIII. Duratio mundi est spatium illud tem-
poris inde a primo mundi exordio vsque ad i-
psius exitum ac finem. Hoc ex traditione Eliae defi-
nitur (ex[?] millibus annorum. Sed nos infra in Chronolo-
gia demonstrauimus ex Dan. 12. & Apoc. 20. longius esse
extendendum hoc spatium, vt fiat annorum 6642. Quaeris
quomodo fit periturus mundus? Resp. ex 2. Petr. 2. v. 12. 13.
coeli conflagrantes soluentur, & elementa aestuantia li-
quescent, igne scil. calcinationis miraculosae, quae longo
interuallo superabit calcinationem corporum ar-
tificialem, qua illa rediguntur in cinerem,
& ex cinere fit corpus glo-
riosum[?].

page.notes: Running head and page number are clear. The margin numbers 10 to 35 are printed line numbers, given here as right-side notes. "(ex" after "defi-" is uncertain, marked [?]. "riosum" at the line end is uncertain (the s may be a long s), marked [?]. "periturus" is read as printed. The catchword "X. ARITH-" is printed at the lower right. The Scripture references are copied as printed, with spacing approximated. The "XI." to "XIII." numerals are italic theses and are kept as paragraphs, not headings.
